acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Flame Elementals family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Magma Lord, T4, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Fissure-Mantle Champion (Champion) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Cracked obsidian shell over living fire, molten rock in fissures, and a mantle of smoke.
Signature mechanic: Fissure Mantle: molten rock routes through three obsidian shell seams, then one segment opens into a sweeping flame gate.
battlefieldDuty: Control alternating safe lanes by opening source-supported obsidian fissures beneath a smoke mantle.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T3 have no obsidian shell, no molten rock, no star, no corona, and no crown; T4 alone gains source-supported obsidian shell and molten rock; T5 alone gains its star, corona, and crown.
Pressurized water jackets, coherent steam loops, wet reflective valve collars, visible condensation return, and exposed drainage cores sustain rather than extinguish the native body.
counterplay: Stand behind the dark shell segment and break its cooling seam after the gate passes. Affinity signal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T3 have no obsidian shell, no molten rock, no star, no corona, and no crown, so pressure loss opens a jacket valve; T4 obsidian shell and molten rock expose a quench fissure; T5 star, corona, and crown contract when the return loop drains.
forbiddenTreatments: Water that erases native living fire
identityInvariants: A roughly humanoid upper silhouette dissolves into flame above and tapers or hovers below with no feet.
Temperature remains legible from dull orange through yellow-white to blue-white edges.
Open flame, ember, smoke, and later source-supported obsidian and molten rock stay materially distinct.
Core definition and directed combustion progress from a flicker to a sovereign star while heat remains readable rather than overexposed.
telegraph: The smoke mantle lifts and one molten fissure brightens from chest to arm.
